title_khamyang: Pung1 Pu5 Yaa3 Haw1 Maa1 Thaang1 Doi1 Pat4 Kai1
title_english: The Migration of Our Ancestors across the Patkai Range
informant: Elder Chaw Sa Myat Chowlik & Deben Chowlik
description: Oral historical narrative recounting the migration of the Khamyang (Nora) clans from Mung Mau through the Patkai mountain pass into Upper Assam.

sentences.text_roman: pu5 yaa3 haw1 khao5 maa1 thaang1 doi1 pat4 kai1
sentences.assamese_script: পু⁵ য়া³ হাও¹ খাও⁵ মা¹ থাং¹ দৈ¹ পেত⁴ কাই¹
sentences.free_translation_en: Our ancestors crossed over and came along the path of the Patkai mountains.
sentences.free_translation_as: আমাৰ পূৰ্বপুৰুষসকল পাতকাই পাহাৰৰ বাটেৰে পাৰ হৈ আহিছিল।
sentences.speaker: Traditional / Elder

sentences.text_roman: khaw1 maa1 yu5 rim1 nam6 jin1

sentences.free_translation_en: They came and settled along the banks of the Buridihing river (Nam Jin).
sentences.free_translation_as: তেওঁলোকে আহি বুঢ়ীদিহিং (নাম জিন) নদীৰ পাৰত বসতি স্থাপন কৰিছিল।
sentences.speaker: Traditional / Elder

sentences.text_roman: maan3 nai6 hɔng3 maan3 paa1 waai6
sentences.assamese_script: মান³ নাই⁶ হং³ মান³ পা¹ ৱাই⁶
sentences.free_translation_en: This village was named Powaimukh (Village at the River-Mouth of Rattan).
sentences.free_translation_as: এই গাঁওখনৰ নাম পোৱাইমুখ (বেতগছৰ নৈৰ মুখৰ গাঁও) ৰখা হ'ল।
sentences.speaker: Traditional / Elder

title_english: The Folktale of the Water Buffalo and the Tiger

sentences.speaker: Traditional / Elder

sentences.free_translation_en: Do not wander astray into the deep forest and wild mountains.
sentences.free_translation_as: গভীৰ অৰণ্য আৰু অচিনাকি পাহাৰত হেৰাই নাথাকিবা।
sentences.speaker: Traditional / Elder

sentences.speaker: Traditional / Elder

description: Sacred Tai chronicle relating the descent of the divine celestial ancestors Khun Lung and Khun Lai from heaven to rule over Mung Mau.

sentences.speaker: Traditional / Elder

sentences.free_translation_en: They established the glorious kingdom of Mung Mau along the fertile river Mau (Shweli).
